Name: Diverse Stardew Valley (DSV) Additional Characters - Townspeople
Author: AirynS
Description:
[center][b][size=4]﻿﻿[/size][size=6]Diverse Stardew Valley Additional Packs - Townspeople[/size][/b][/center][b]
[/b]
[size=3]These individual character packs adapt various other character designs to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url]﻿'s seasonal and festival outfits, as well as enabling full compatibility with DSV's additional options, dialogue, and content.[size=3] This page contains additional character packs for the vanilla [b]non-romanceable characters [/b]- for character packs involving marriage candidates, see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23917]Diverse Stardew Valley Additional Packs - Romanceables[/url]﻿.[/size]
[/size]

[size=3][size=3][img]https://imgur.com/0R7biKQ.png[/img]﻿

[size=3]Each additional character pack requires [size=3][size=3][size=3][url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/470174-content-patcher]Content Patcher[/url][/size][/size][/size] and the SMAPI modding framework; if you have not installed SMAPI before, see the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started]Stardew Valley Wiki's guide[/url] for instructions. They also require [size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley - Seasonal Outfits[/url]﻿.[/size][/size][/size] Most character packs based on an existing individual character mod also require the original mod to be installed; these will be noted in the Features descriptions.

Each character pack can be used individually without requiring any other character pack.

[size=3][size=3][img]https://imgur.com/v0kYolw.png[/img][/size][/size]

To use a character pack, [size=3]To use a character pack, [b]you will need to select the add-on pack in the corresponding character variant config in Diverse Stardew Valley's configuration options, then save your config and reload the game once.[/b][/size] 

T[size=3]he easiest way to do this is with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] mod. GMCM adds a small cog-shaped button to the lower-left corner of the Stardew Valley title screen, which allows you to edit config options in-game via an easy-to-use interface with either check boxes or scrollable drop-down menus. Once GMCM is downloaded and installed, DSV will automatically detect it and become available for configuration from the title screen.

The majority of character packs can make use of DSV's configuration options, e.g. if PennyFreckles is enabled in DSV, Brunette Penny will also have freckles. For more information and detailed explanations of DSV's configuration options, see the [url=https://diversestardewvalley.weebly.com/]Diverse Stardew Valley website.[/url] DSV's dialogue and other content is also compatible depending on whether it is appropriate for the character pack, e.g. Native Leah's dialogue will also apply if using Butch Native Leah, but not if using Ashbrass's Leah.

Several character packs have additional [/size]options that are not available through DSV's standard options. These can be found in the [b]Additional Packs [/b]section of DSV's configuration page.

[size=3][size=3][size=3]Unless otherwise noted, all additional character packs are also compatible[/size][/size] with any mods that Diverse Stardew Valley is compatible with (as of DSV 5.1.0).[/size]

[size=3][size=3][img]https://imgur.com/XrWdUgj.png[/img][/size][/size]

[/size][size=5][b]CAROLINE[/b][/size][size=3]

[img]https://imgur.com/bxlrlZh.png[/img]

[b]Green-Haired Modded Caroline by Alkanthe & Airyn[/b]. All options for Modded Caroline are compatible.[/size]

[img]https://imgur.com/0ZWQYHl.png[/img][size=3]

[b]Brunette Caroline by Airyn[/b]. All options for Vanilla Caroline are compatible.


[size=5][b]CLINT[/b][/size][size=3]

[img]https://imgur.com/A0Aj6dX.png[/img]

[b]Hot Clint by K2Sync & Silvermoonchan[/b]. This pack combines [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29441]Hot Clint[/url]'s portraits with DSV's sprites for Modded Clint and requires the original mod. All options for Modded Clint are compatible except ClintScar, which is built into the design by default. Not compatible with Looking for Love or Clint Reforged.[/size]

[/size]
[b][size=5]DEMETRIUS[/size][/b]


[size=3][img]https://imgur.com/NLTciBz.png[/img]

[b]Sprite-Accurate Demetrius by BadMoonBeast[/b]. This pack is an adaptation of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24160]Sprite-Accurate Demetrius[/url], converted by Megan and StickyNote, and requires the original mod. All options for Vanilla Demetrius are compatible.[/size]

[b][size=5]GUS[/size][/b]

[img]https://imgur.com/lFmv6ZQ.png[/img]

[size=3][b]Malaysian Indian Gus by Solo[/b]. All options for Vanilla Gus are compatible.[/size]


[b][size=5]JODI[/size][/b]

[img]https://imgur.com/UhtdvgN.png[/img][img]https://imgur.com/WxDI7qu.png[/img]
[size=3][size=3]
﻿[b]Brunette or Strawberry Blonde Jodi. [/b]All options for Vanilla Jodi are compatible.

This pack has an additional option: JodiHairColor, which toggles whether Jodi has brunette hair (matching her vanilla sprites) or strawberry blonde hair (matching her vanilla portraits).

[img]https://imgur.com/9wrMRSP.png[/img]
[/size][/size]
[size=3][b]Lighter Iranian Jodi by HopefulFox.[/b] All options for Modded Jodi are compatible.


[size=6][b]MARNIE[/b][/size][size=3]
[/size]
[img]https://imgur.com/frLTcUu.png[/img]

[b]Older Marnie by Slumberwood[/b]. This pack is an adaptation of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31092]Older Marnie [/url]and requires the original mod. All options for Vanilla Marnie are compatible. Not compatible with Looking for Love.


[/size][size=6][b]MORRIS[/b][/size][size=3]

[/size][img]https://imgur.com/nKvYPq7.png[/img]﻿﻿

[size=3][b]Professional Morris by Airyn[/b]. This pack [/size][size=3]is an adaptation of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14683]Professional Morris [/url]and requires the original mod. All options for Vanilla Morris are compatible.[/size]


[size=6][b]PAM[/b][/size]

[img]https://imgur.com/oOWrDaB.png[/img]﻿

[size=3][b]Younger Pam by Sivolobwho[/b]. This pack is an adaptation of Young Pam from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/366]Siv's Marriage Mod [/url]and while it does not require the original mod as it is not a single character mod, we encourage anyone using this character pack to please download and endorse the original. All options for Vanilla Pam are compatible. Not compatible with Looking for Love.


[/size][size=6][b]SANDY[/b][/size][size=3]

[img]https://imgur.com/LUXNrjD.png[/img]﻿

[/size][size=3][b]Front-Facing Sandy by Poltergeister[/b]. [size=3]This pack is an adaptation of Sandy from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4824]Slightly Edited Portraits [/url]﻿and while it does not require the original mod as it is not a single character mod, we encourage anyone using this character pack to please download and endorse the original. All options for Vanilla Sandy are compatible.[/size]
[/size]

[b][size=6]WILLY[/size][/b]

[img]https://imgur.com/FMmDOcS.png[/img]﻿

[size=3][b]Long-Haired Tongan Disabled Willy by Airyn[/b]. All options for TonganDisabled Willy are compatible.[/size][size=3]


[/size][b][size=6]WIZARD[/size][/b]

[img]https://imgur.com/WHw34NS.png[/img]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/EEaumRH.png[/img]
[size=3]
[/size]
[size=3][b]Handsome Mature Wizard by Airyn[/b]. This pack is an adaptation of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14682/]Handsome Mature Wizard [/url]and requires the original mod. All options for Vanilla and Modded Wizard are compatible.[/size]
[size=3]
This pack has an additional option: HandsomeMatureWizardVariant, which toggles whether to use the Vanilla or Modded version of the Wizard.


[img]https://imgur.com/4vgqnZ2.png[/img]﻿

[/size][size=5][b]We do not accept requests for adaptations of other portrait mods.

[/b][/size][size=3]Previous additional character packs that are not uploaded here are discontinued and will not be updated.

If you are interested in creating an additional character pack, either of your own character design or of someone else's design, see the [url=https://diversestardewvalley.weebly.com/asset-use-permissions.html]Asset Use Permissions[/url] page of the Diverse Stardew Valley website. If adapting someone else's design, you must have permission from them before any assets can be adapted.

[b]Additional character packs may not be kept in sync with content changes to Diverse Stardew Valley[/b]. This is intentional as otherwise the workload would be too much to manage. If you would like a character pack to be updated faster, you are welcome to adapt any changed artwork yourself and send it to me to be uploaded. Otherwise character packs will be updated when I have the time and energy to update them.

Huge thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/riotgirl5989/about-me?gameId=1303]Riot [/url]for her help in updating these character packs to SDV 1.6 and DSV 5.0! [/size]
